mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_gm.t_ms_order(misc_no, title, order_type, ref_type, ref_no, unit_id, supplier_id, applicant_id, dept_id, apply_date, contract_no, amount, tax_rate, amount_tax, pay_date_plan, expect_date, finish_date, next_due_date, cert_no, status, attach_count, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, is_del) VALUES (#{entity.miscNo}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.orderType}, #{entity.refType}, #{entity.refNo}, #{entity.unitId}, #{entity.supplierId}, #{entity.applicantId}, #{entity.deptId}, #{entity.applyDate}, #{entity.contractNo}, #{entity.amount}, #{entity.taxRate}, #{entity.amountTax}, #{entity.payDatePlan}, #{entity.expectDate}, #{entity.finishDate}, #{entity.nextDueDate}, #{entity.certNo}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.attachCount}, #{entity.remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_gm.t_ms_order SET title=#{entity.title}, order_type=#{entity.orderType}, ref_type=#{entity.refType}, ref_no=#{entity.refNo}, unit_id=#{entity.unitId}, supplier_id=#{entity.supplierId}, applicant_id=#{entity.applicantId}, dept_id=#{entity.deptId}, apply_date=#{entity.applyDate}, contract_no=#{entity.contractNo}, amount=#{entity.amount}, tax_rate=#{entity.taxRate}, amount_tax=#{entity.amountTax}, pay_date_plan=#{entity.payDatePlan}, expect_date=#{entity.expectDate}, finish_date=#{entity.finishDate}, next_due_date=#{entity.nextDueDate}, cert_no=#{entity.certNo}, status=#{entity.status}, attach_count=#{entity.attachCount}, remark=#{entity.remark}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE ms_order_id=#{entity.id} AND is_del=0

UPDATE ct_gm.t_ms_order SET amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_ms_order_item WHERE ms_order_id=#{msOrderId} AND is_del=0), amount_tax=ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ct_gm.t_ms_order_item WHERE ms_order_id=#{msOrderId} AND is_del=0) * (1 + tax_rate), 2), updated_at=NOW() WHERE ms_order_id=#{msOrderId} AND is_del=0
UPDATE ct_gm.t_ms_order SET is_del=1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE ms_order_id=#{msOrderId} AND is_del=0
